data.one_liner: Compute CIE color difference (ΔE) using 1976, 1994, and 2000 formulas in pure Dart.
data.what_it_does: The package provides functions to calculate the perceptual difference between two colors in CIELAB space. It supports the three main DeltaE algorithms (cie76, cie94, ciede2000) and offers a unified API.
use_when: You need to compare two colors for perceptual similarity in a design or image processing workflow.
You want to validate color differences against industry standards in a Flutter or Dart project.
You need a lightweight, dependency-free solution for color difference calculations.
You are building a tool that requires accurate color matching or tolerance checks.
avoid_when: You require a full color management or conversion library beyond ΔE calculations.
You need to work with color spaces other than CIELAB without additional conversion utilities.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies.
Supports all three major DeltaE algorithms with optional weighting.
No external build steps or code generation required.
Compatible with all platforms (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux).
weaknesses: Limited to color difference calculations only; no color conversion utilities.
No support for other color spaces or advanced color management features.
